faq.q: Do you charge to come out to Richmond Hill?
faq.p-2: No. The inspection visit is free, at your home. A technician looks at the chimney, shows you what they found, and gives you a price on the spot. You decide from there.
faq.q-2: How soon can you get to Richmond Hill?
faq.p-3: Call {{site.phone}} and we will give you the earliest real slot for your area. We work every day, {{site.hours}}.
faq.q-3: Do you do both wood-burning and gas fireplaces?
faq.p-4: Yes. They need different attention, so tell us which you have when you call and we will send the right person.
faq.q-4: Will the sweep make a mess in my house?
faq.p-5: No. Floors and the fireplace area are covered before any tool comes out, the vacuum runs while we sweep, and the area is left the way we found it — or cleaner.
faq.q-5: Do you work Saturdays and Sundays?
faq.p-6: Yes. Every day, {{site.hours}}, at the same price as a weekday.
faq.q-6: What chimney work do you do in Richmond Hill?
faq.p-7: The same as everywhere we work: cleaning, inspections, repairs, caps, liners, masonry and tuckpointing, flashing, maintenance and fireplace repair. Every job starts with the free inspection.

near.p: Not on the list? Call and ask — we cover Toronto and most of the GTA.
